title: KS-1087: Item 2 (workflow-approve forwards a credential originate accepts): build it or wait for proof?
bluf: Item 1 is merged (PR #1008): a refused forward now answers 502 and keeps the pending document. Item 2 remains: the gateway forwards only x-user-id, and originate answered 401 in the gate's replay, so a final approval in that state fails (502, document kept). Whether any environment has workflow-gated document types is NOT established (unverified), so real-user reach is unknown. Item 2 is called 'a design call' and sits beside KS-1184 (workflow stranded after a refused forward). Building item 2 touches the auth path of document creation in production.

sources.quote: the forward carries x-user-id alone, and originate answers 401
NOT established: whether any environment has workflow-gated document types
No one has yet shown this path is reached by a document type that actually routes through workflow approval

options.label: Build item 2: forward a credential originate accepts (auth-path production change)
options.detail: Makes final workflow approval able to succeed. Needs a design and Opus-level gate; decide together with KS-1184.

options.label: Wait: measure read-only whether workflow-gated document types exist; no build
options.detail: No production change. Item 1 already stops silent loss.

options.label: Rule workflow-approve out of scope; close item 2
options.detail: Board-only. Approvals that need originate auth keep returning 502.

default_action: After 48 h option b applies: no build; item 2 stays open until reachability is measured. Safest and reversible (item 1 already protects the document).
